issue.title: Album and record collision tests assume case-sensitive paths and fail on macOS
issue.description:
Found by bob-cli-l3.land while fulfilling bob-cli-l3.1 note #3's requested macOS collision audit. Not caused by l3: blame dates every failing assumption before its b7f74b58 test-only change, to closed album and record epics.

At b7f74b584481453d4e1446d032072cff1405479c, macOS job 131547552217 in https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli/actions/runs/43322752069 completed its lib and CLI binaries before the job was cancelled. Four deterministic filesystem-sensitive failures occur while their Linux counterparts pass:

- native::albums::create::tests::stale_plan_notices_a_collision_introduced_after_planning (src/native/albums/create.rs:1085): planting EAT.base correctly invalidates the plan via the missing-file preimage, reporting `eat.base appeared on disk after planning`; the assertion demands `namespace` instead. Added by 0c8df969 / k3.6.1.
- native::albums::registry::tests::stem_noun_and_case_insensitive_folder_collisions_invalidate_all_claims (registry.rs:1189): writes Eat.md and eat.md but the case-insensitive filesystem stores one file; expected two paths, actual [Eat.md]. Added by b6f3b92c / k3.2.1.2.
- albums_create::create_normalizes_mixed_case_stems_and_takes_path_qualified_parents (tests/cli/albums_create.rs:696): asserts !Eat.md.exists() after successfully creating eat.md. Added by aef23542 / k3.6.1.3.
- capture::record::record_exists_fix_uses_a_staged_target_but_not_an_incomplete_or_unsafe_one (tests/cli/capture/record.rs:613): writes ninja_sushi.md and NINJA_SUSHI.md, which alias one record, so the expected ambiguous-collision refusal cannot exist. Added by a729a8fd / ir.7.1.4.

Bounded test-portability repair: assert the actual stored filename through directory enumeration; preserve collision rejection while accepting the correct first failing read-dependency guard; construct case-folded ambiguity in a portable synthetic/overlay fixture or separate real-volume capability-dependent coverage from the always-run core assertions. Do not weaken collision protections, skip whole tests on macOS, or change correct product behavior just to satisfy Linux-only fixture assumptions.

Run focused nodes and just check on Linux; validate the same tree on macOS, using scripts/dev/macos-ci-check via /sase_monitor for the long gate. Other established failures (gcal l2, pipe drain kl, completion g8) are independent. Never run check-full for this task. No duplicate found in same-type and broader task searches, last-week sweep, or active epic causal review. Size medium: four localized assertions/fixtures with one precise cross-platform cause, one coding agent can repair directly.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The exact macOS log failures follow deterministically from case-insensitive filesystem semantics: case-variant paths alias one file and preimage checks fire before namespace guards. Linux passes on the same SHA. Source blame predates l3; these are filesystem-dependent fixture assumptions, not timing assertions.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-l3 land audit recovered completed test results from a cancelled macOS CI job and found four deterministic fixture/assertion failures that predate the epic. They need an independent portability fix so the release train can pass on macOS.

payload.description: The phase requested macOS collision verification; its fixture migration is separate from these older filesystem assumptions

evidence.note: Independent repro 2026-11-14 (agent dz): exact-SHA CI https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli/actions/runs/43598958555 (snapshot 41ce39f4 = master 575f9e66 + the macOS ptsname_r fix that now lets macOS reach its test step) fails exactly these four on macos-latest and nowhere else: albums::create stale_plan_notices_a_collision_introduced_after_planning ('eat.base appeared on disk after planning'), albums::registry stem_noun_and_case_insensitive_folder_collisions_invalidate_all_claims (left [Eat.md], right [Eat.md, eat.md]), albums_create create_normalizes_mixed_case_stems_and_takes_path_qualified_parents (!Eat.md.exists()), capture::record record_exists_fix_uses_a_staged_target_but_not_an_incomplete_or_unsafe_one (collision.get(rewrite).is_none()). With ptsname_r fixed, these four plus bob-cli-kl and the gcal-ack macOS termios failures (noted on epic bob-cli-l5) are what stands between master and the next release.
